Manchester City and PSG Clash in Champions League Amid Financial Rule Breach Findings

Manchester City hosted Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) in a Champions League match at the Etihad Stadium. This game marked Manchester City's first home match since being found guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules over nearly a decade. The match itself saw PSG score within 13 minutes, with one report describing Manchester City's defiance as short-lived.
